problems.reason: Sentence 8 states the fossils come from the Campanian-age Kirtland Formation, while sentence 9 claims the species lived from 83.6 to 72.2 Ma, a range that extends into the Maastrichtian, contradicting the strictly Campanian age of the formation.

notes: - contradiction: "The fossils come from the Campanian-age Kirtland Formation." / "The animal lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.": Sentence 8 states the fossils come from the Campanian-age Kirtland Formation, while sentence 9 claims the species lived from 83.6 to 72.2 Ma, a range that extends into the Maastrichtian, contradicting the strictly Campanian age of the formation.
